items.question: According to Air Arabia, up to which week of a single pregnancy can a woman travel by air, provided a valid medical certificate is submitted?
items.fact: Air Arabia allows single-pregnancy air travel until week 35.

items.question: Under the rules of UAE-based airlines for children, what is the age below which a child cannot travel alone?
items.gold: Children below the age of 5 years cannot travel alone.
items.fact: UAE-based airlines bar children under 5 from travelling alone.
